description: The rules that make a number from this corpus MEAN something. Published machine-readably because a cloner reaches the same Parquet by CLI, web app, MCP, or `duckdb` at a shell prompt, and only the Python route touches any of them. Every invariant here was learned expensively, most from a defect this project shipped.
read_this_first: `probe.integrity_check` names the `manifest.integrity_check` code that VERIFIES the invariant, or is null with the reason there is none. A declared invariant nobody verifies is a comment, and this codebase has been burned by comments that were true when written.

invariants.title: INDEPENDENCE
invariants.statement: INDEPENDENCE — seeds are independent; generations within a lineage are not
invariants.failure_without_it: counting the nine (seed, generation) cells of a 3×3 design as n = 9 rather than n = 3
invariants.evidence: `support.py:16-17,32-33`; the case is written up in `docs/ROUTE1_CORPUS_RECORD.md:136-140` — the inflated n made a paired test reach significance on an arm that was mathematically incapable of having an effect. `stats.py:46-57` holds the cluster machinery and the record of two withdrawn cluster variables (machine: ICC 0.0 at fixed depth; depth: a fixed, not random, effect)

probe.how: independence is a COUNTING rule about how a caller aggregates, not a property of any row; D12 verifies the stratum column is present so the rule CAN be applied

invariants.title: COMPARABILITY
invariants.statement: COMPARABILITY — elongation model, operon setting, medium and `kb_sha256` partition the corpus
invariants.failure_without_it: pooling runs from two partitions into one mean
invariants.evidence: `capability.py:29-40` — the 86-wide `fraction_trna_charged` is a broadcast identity / 86 independent values / 86 exact zeros depending on mode; `manifest.py:275-294` (`_design_tag` puts the mode into identity); `factors.py:248-255` (`one_factor_neighbours` refuses a cross-mode control: same elongation model is "a precondition, not a fourth factor"); `audit.py:58-63`. `capability.py` refuses on the elongation axis; nothing refuses on `kb_sha256` → `M-11`. MEASURED 2026-08-03 — `kb_sha256` IS UNSOUND IN ONE DIRECTION and `M-11` must not be built on it as written. Two ParCa runs of the SAME image

probe.how: every row carries kb provenance; D8/D9 cover the elongation half; D11 catches a design key that omits a partitioning key the corpus actually splits on

invariants.title: REPORTABILITY
invariants.statement: REPORTABILITY — crash rows and QC-failed runs are in the table and look like data
invariants.failure_without_it: `WHERE reportable` deletes the lethality phenotype; not filtering silently Welch-tests crashed runs
invariants.evidence: `qc.py:62-65` — reportable iff every generation is ok; `survey.py:197-198` drops non-reportable and tombstoned rows; `differential.py:28` records the version that did not filter. MEASURED: 101/322 non-reportable (breakdown above) — and some of them are results, not failures

probe.how: reportability is enforced at the read boundary (survey.analysis_rows), not checkable per row — a crash row is VALID data that must not be silently filtered OR silently pooled

invariants.title: NULL IS NOT FALSE
invariants.statement: NULL IS NOT FALSE — unmeasured must never read as a negative observation
invariants.failure_without_it: SQL three-valued logic and Python truthiness return two different corpora, with no error on either
invariants.evidence: `store.py:107-112` — 36 of 272 rows had NULL viability columns and `bool(None)` turned not measured into did not divide, producing three false IMPAIRED verdicts. MEASURED today: 26 rows have `crashed IS NULL` and all 26 are `reportable=True`; `WHERE NOT crashed` returns 233 of 322 (the 26 are dropped), while Python `if not r['crashed']` keeps them

probe.how: NULL in a column used as a filter, which SQL three-valued logic and Python truthiness read differently with no error on either

invariants.title: GENERATION DEPTH IS A STRATUM, NOT NOISE
invariants.statement: GENERATION DEPTH IS A STRATUM, NOT NOISE
invariants.failure_without_it: comparing designs at unequal depth, believing you are averaging over generations
invariants.evidence: A channel is the last generation's time-mean (`_reader_worker.py:203`, `_dynamics(gs[-1])`); recorded measurement: `growth_rate == per_generation[-1]` on 91/91 rows, `== mean over generations` on 0/91. So depth selects which generation you read: ICC 0.6795 at the reported index vs 0.0000 at matched generation 0; six designs flip sign; `rRNA_KO:2op` −7.4 % → +2.2 % (`survey.py:44-90`). `support.compare():93-110` is the depth check. MEASURED today, all 322 rows: depth 0:65 · 1:125 · 3:13 · 4:108 · 7:7 · 8:4 — unequal depth is the norm

probe.how: a row missing its `generations` stratum cannot be compared at equal depth

invariants.title: IDENTITY IS THE `ko_index` SET, NEVER THE GENE NAME
invariants.statement: IDENTITY IS THE `ko_index` SET, NEVER THE GENE NAME
invariants.failure_without_it: treating an alias as a distinct experiment, or a design as a single-gene knockout
invariants.evidence: `factors.py:11-20` — 4,538 genes collapse onto 2,984 indices; 1,554 names are aliases; `KO:pheS`/`pheT`/`pheM`/`thrS`/`infC`/`ihfA` are one run. `KO:flgB` deletes nine genes; `KO:rpoB` does not silence rpoB; `KO:rpmJ` silences `secY` (operons-ON semantics, `docs/KNOCKOUT_SEMANTICS.md`). `factors.dedupe():262-273`, invariant D4 (`manifest.py:810`). MEASURED: 7 rows carry `qc='noop_knockout'` — a wild type wearing a KO label

probe.how: no two distinct design keys share a canonical experiment id

invariants.title: NO DESIGN KEY MAY BE BUILT FROM A NULLABLE COLUMN
invariants.statement: NO DESIGN KEY MAY BE BUILT FROM A NULLABLE COLUMN
invariants.failure_without_it: two opposite experiments merging into one design and averaging
invariants.evidence: `survey.py:95-118` — every `timeline` run stores `condition=NULL`, so an amino-acid upshift and a downshift both key to `timeline/None` and report as 4 seeds of one design. Invariant D3 (`manifest.py:809`), CI-pinned in `tests/test_corpus_integrity.py:52-73`

invariants.title: RECORDER TRUNCATION
invariants.statement: RECORDER TRUNCATION — a fixed-width string column silently loses data
invariants.failure_without_it: trusting the recorded timeline as what actually ran
invariants.evidence: `serialization.py:1-30` — `FBAResults/media_id` is sized from its first value, so `'minimal_plus_amino_acids'[:7] == 'minimal'` and a nutrient shift vanishes from the record while the sim performed it. Numeric damage (`segments.py:1-30`): one segment spanning the whole generation reported `fba_objective` ≈ 7.9 for a quantity going 0.81 → 14.1. Detector is cross-run dtype-width comparison — the corpus convicts itself, no external expectation needed

probe.how: verified by `serialization.scan_corpus`, which reads the simOut dtypes — not a manifest property

invariants.title: IN-SAMPLE ≠ OUT-OF-SAMPLE
invariants.failure_without_it: reading agreement in a ParCa-fitted condition as predictive validation
invariants.evidence: `provenance.py:1-27` — the fitted set is deliberately conservative and pinned by `test_provenance.test_in_sample_set_is_pinned`. Hygiene gap: the tag is computed at read time in Python (`store.py:56-57`) and is not a column, so a non-Python reader never sees it

probe.how: the `provenance` column now ships on every new row (H-17a/B4), so a direct reader can apply it; older rows carry NULL and the tag is recomputed at read time

invariants.title: A MISSING MECHANISM IS A REFUSAL, NEVER A ZERO
invariants.statement: A MISSING MECHANISM IS A REFUSAL, NEVER A ZERO
invariants.failure_without_it: reporting an algebraic identity as a measurement
invariants.evidence: `capability.py:1-15` — a within-family tRNA charging spread of `0.00e+00` was an identity at `polypeptide_elongation.py:163`, reported as a finding. The `check()` contract (`capability.py:536-539`): a False `can_answer` always carries a refusal and never a value

probe.how: verified by `capability.probe()`, which greps the model checkout so a stale declaration is caught

invariants.title: APPEND-ONLY, SUPERSEDE, NEVER MUTATE
invariants.statement: APPEND-ONLY, SUPERSEDE, NEVER MUTATE — AND FILTER AFTER DEDUP
invariants.failure_without_it: a stale row surviving a valid correction
invariants.evidence: `manifest.py:66-72` — a correction that rewrote `simout_path` rewrote half the dedup key and minted a new row instead of superseding. `manifest.py:867-871` — SQL applies `WHERE` before `QUALIFY`, so filtering first dedups among the offending rows alone and reports the stale row even after a valid correction: an invariant unsatisfiable by correction. Tombstones (`manifest.drop_run():100-150`, `survey._mark_dropped():165-175`) are excluded from ranking but kept in coverage; a drop with no reason is refused

probe.how: a correction that rewrites half the dedup key mints a row instead of superseding, and the stored design_key then disagrees with the derived one

invariants.title: ORPHANS AND PHANTOMS
invariants.statement: ORPHANS AND PHANTOMS — readable on disk ≠ visible to any query, and vice versa
invariants.failure_without_it: an entire design silently absent from an audit
invariants.evidence: invariant D7 (`manifest.py:813`): a whole `valS` design stayed invisible through an entire audit because it was readable but unindexed (`tests/test_corpus_integrity.py:256-258`). The reverse — indexed, run dir gone — is still valid for channels (`manifest.reconcile_disk():928+`)

probe.how: runs readable on disk but not indexed, hence invisible to every query

invariants.title: RAW-LOCAL ≠ INDEXED ≠ DOWNLOADABLE; unverified is never "absent"
invariants.statement: RAW-LOCAL ≠ INDEXED ≠ DOWNLOADABLE; unverified is never "absent"
invariants.failure_without_it: refusing a legitimate pull, or reporting a public dataset as missing
invariants.evidence: `hf.py:28-42` — a remnant run dir counted as local, so `download_raw` refused a legitimate pull while gene-level tools failed. `hf.py:189-211` — HF presence is `True`/`False`/`None`, and a download command is emitted only when presence is CONFIRMED. The recorded incident (`hf.py:78-85`): a stale OAuth token made `HfApi()` 401 on a public dataset while `HfApi(token=False)` succeeded at the same moment, every row reported "available: false", and the wrong diagnosis was filed. This is the silent-absence bug class at the storage boundary

probe.how: raw-local vs indexed vs downloadable is a per-call availability question; `data_availability` and `raw_available` model it, and `raw_available=0` must never be reported as absent

invariants.title: ENVELOPE
invariants.statement: ENVELOPE — some runs are data-shaped but not interpretable
invariants.failure_without_it: quoting channels from mechanistically invalid generations
invariants.evidence: `envelope.py:1-8,30` — a mid-simulation carbon switch to acetate/succinate/fumarate/malate desynchronises replication–division; those carbon sources exist only as static fitted conditions

probe.how: the envelope is checked BEFORE a run launches (`envelope.check`), so an out-of-envelope row should not exist; there is no post-hoc probe and that is a gap worth closing

invariants.title: AGGREGATE COLUMNS HIDE THE SHAPE; not every column is an observable
invariants.statement: AGGREGATE COLUMNS HIDE THE SHAPE; not every column is an observable
invariants.failure_without_it: concluding "charging is fine" from a mean that cannot show the phenotype
invariants.evidence: the manifest's `fraction_trna_charged` is a single mean over families and cannot show cognate-family de-charging — one family starves while ~19 stay loaded (`tools.py:1241`). `survey.py:25` excludes `fba_objective` from the biological ranking as a solver diagnostic

probe.how: which columns are observables is a modelling fact, declared in `capability`; no row-level probe

invariants.title: THE KNOWLEDGE BASE IS PART OF THE EXPERIMENT
invariants.statement: THE KNOWLEDGE BASE IS PART OF THE EXPERIMENT — operon mode is a ParCa option, not a sim option
invariants.failure_without_it: treating two ParCa builds as rows in one comparison
invariants.evidence: there is no per-simulation override, so switching produces a different `simData.cPickle`: the two modes are separate arms, never rows in one comparison (`operons.py` MECHANISM). Every row carries `operons` + `kb_sha256` (`manifest.py:379`, `provenance.kb_provenance():71-120`). Note the operon half is ARGUED from the ParCa mechanism, not measured — all 322 rows are `operons='on'` and no knockout has ever run under OFF

probe.how: the operon mode rides on every row, so two ParCa builds cannot be mistaken for one arm

invariants.title: A GENERATION CAN BE MISSING ITS END AND STILL READ AS COMPLETE
invariants.statement: A GENERATION CAN BE MISSING ITS END AND STILL READ AS COMPLETE — the last timestep of generation n must meet the first timestep of generation n+1
invariants.failure_without_it: quoting a generation's duration, final mass, or time-mean from a lineage whose data stops before the division that ended it
invariants.evidence: MEASURED 2026-08-03, item 7. Auditing all 269 generation boundaries in the local corpus (`Main/time` of gen n vs gen n+1): 2 have a gap — `wildtype_374656/000000` gen 0 ends at 2047 s while gen 1 starts at 2530 s (482 timesteps, 19.1 %, missing), and `wildtype_374656/000001` gen 0 ends at 478 s while gen 1 starts at 2574 s (2095 s, 81.4 %, missing). Both lack `Daughter_inherited_state.cPickle`; every intact generation has it. The manifest reports the seed-0 lineage as `qc='ok'`, `generation_qc` all `"ok"`, `reportable=True` — so `generation_qc` does not detect end-truncation. Damage measured:

probe.how: continuity between generations is measured from raw simOut, not from the manifest; `qc` covers the run-level half
